rich_text.plain_text: Norwegian just sticks words together

text.content: Norwegian just sticks words together

rich_text.plain_text: English breaks compounds apart, so we get "morning stretch" and "wine evening" as two words each. Norwegian jams them into one: morgenstrekk, vinkveld. The result is a language that can name a very specific pleasure in a single word and then use it as though everyone already agreed it deserved one.
